issue_text: What’s the car rental cancellation policy in general for my Las Vegas trip? I want to know whether I’d be charged anything if I cancel that rental.
summary: The agent handled a cancellation session for a Las Vegas trip. T1 answered the general car-rental cancellation policy and gently corrected the premise (no Las Vegas rentals were on the account at that point); T2 looked up CR-68B7 and confirmed its details against what the user described (Enterprise, McCarran airport, Economy, $138); T3 cancelled it with a $0 fee and full $138 refund. The single live contradiction lands in T4: the user re-describes the cancelled rental as 'the downtown Las Vegas rental office'. The agent recalled the true McCarran-airport location, stated it 'does not match what you just described', and asked the user to 'double-check whether CR-68B7 was the right one' — a full DETECT+FLAG, so trap_0's flag-the-inconsistency subgoal (rare in this cell) PASSes. T5 cancelled hotel HR-68D9 ($298 refund), T6 confirmed no reservations/flights remain, and T7 wrapped up with a $436 total refund. Traps 1–3 (price $149, Luxury class, Sep 19–22 dates) never got introduced before END_CONVERSATION, so those contradictions never fired and their detect subgoals FAIL vacuously (10/16 credited).

findings.body: Three of four planned contradictions (price, class, dates) were never surfaced by the user before the session ended, so their 'detect' subgoals FAIL vacuously — a reminder that a FAIL in the validator can mean 'never tested', not 'got it wrong'.
